messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Oskar picked up the Ember on-call shift from Diego on 2026-06-17. [decision; valid 2026-06-17 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-06-17]
- As of 2026-05-28, Yuki Tanaka still has the Cinder pager. [valid 2026-05-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-05-28]
- Team Ember reported at standup on 2026-05-27 that the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-27]
- Diego has the Ember pager as of the 2026-05-13 cycle, taking over from Oskar. [decision; valid 2026-05-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-13]
    earlier: Oskar has the Ember pager as of the 2026-03-16 cycle, taking over from Diego. [decision; valid 2026-03-16 to 2026-05-13; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-16]
    earlier: Diego carries the Team Ember on-call phone as of the 2026-01-23 on-call swap, until the next rotation. [decision; valid 2026-01-23 to 2026-03-16; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-23]
    earlier: Oskar is on call for team Ember this cycle. [valid 2025-05-28 to 2026-01-23; recorded by standup/ember/2025-05-28]
- On 2026-05-01, the Cinder team observed that the flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send. [valid 2026-05-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-05-01-2]
- As of 2026-05-01, Ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC instead of on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [decision; valid 2026-05-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-05-01]
- On 2026-04-29, Ember noticed that the resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-29]
- Ledger is owned by Cinder as of 2026-04-29, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-29-ledger]
    earlier: Ledger is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-12-10, after Team Atlas handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-10 to 2026-04-29; recorded by handover/2025-12-10-ledger]
    earlier: Ledger is owned by Team Atlas as of 2025-01-08. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-12-10; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- Cinder took over Ledger from Boreal on 2026-04-29. [decision; valid 2026-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-29-ledger]
- Cinder observed at standup on 2026-04-17 that the authentication gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2026-04-17 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-04-17]
- Ledger is not Team Atlas's service, so Team Atlas flagged the disk usage jump instead of fixing it. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16-2]
- Team Atlas saw on 2026-04-16 that Ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change. [valid 2026-04-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-16-2]
- The notifier is owned by team Boreal as of 2026-04-06, after the Cinder team handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-06 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-06-notifier]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by team Cinder as of 2026-03-17. [valid 2026-03-17 to 2026-04-06; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-17]
- Yuki walked Lena through the notifier runbook on 2026-04-06. [valid 2026-04-06 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-06-notifier]
- The notifier moved from the Cinder team to team Boreal as of 2026-04-06. [decision; valid 2026-04-06 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-06-notifier]
- On 2026-03-16, Ember noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-16 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-16]
- Boreal announced at standup on 2026-03-13 a deploy freeze for Ledger from 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-03 for the fiscal year close. [constraint; valid 2026-03-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-13]
- Billing-api depends on Ledger to work. [constraint; valid 2026-03-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-05]
- The webhooks service will require an idempotency key on every delivery. [decision; valid 2026-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- Yuki walked Farah through the flags service runbook on 2026-01-29. [valid 2026-01-29 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-29-feature-flags]

Question: Which team is Diego on now?

message.reasoning:
The question asks which team Diego is on now. The memory mentions Diego handing over Ember on-call to Oskar on 2026-06-17, and Diego having the Ember pager from 2026-05-13. This tells us Diego was involved with Team Ember, but does the memory explicitly state which team Diego is on? It says Diego has the Ember pager, Diego picked up... but that indicates Diego was on Team Ember's rotation. However, does the memory state Diego's team membership? It says "Oskar picked up the Ember on-call shift from Diego" — Diego held the Ember pager, so Diego is presumably on Team Ember. But strictly, the memory doesn't say "Diego is on Team Ember." It says Diego carries the Team Ember on-call phone. That suggests Diego is on Team Ember.

The rules say answer only from memory. The memory implies Diego is on Team Ember (he's had the Ember pager/on-call). The most reasonable answer: Team Ember. But is that a guess? The memory says Diego has the Ember pager as of 2026-05-13 cycle, and later Oskar picked up from Diego. Being on a team's pager rotation implies team membership. I think the answer is Team Ember.
